stations.title: Rosa
stations.say: Why did Priya get three texts?

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: Texts all go to one phone

captions: Next, Rosa forwards a complaint: Priya got three reminder texts, Amara got none.
Each text goes out on time, but every one of them goes to Priya's phone.
You catch it, fix the reminders and write the test, in three tasks.
Now Amara's reminder reaches Amara, and each text finds its own person.
Same bookings, same times. Every customer gets their own text.
